description:

Olá, pessoa genial!

Somos uma Startup (Edtech) em crescimento, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para decolar e, claro, MUITOS desafios! Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te auxiliar a maximizar todo o seu potencial de gerar o maior impacto positivo possível!

Sonhamos alto e apostamos no potencial das nossas pessoas, acreditando que cada um tem um papel fundamental na nossa jornada e no alcance dos nossos objetivos. Temos o compromisso de ser uma empresa onde todos tenham a oportunidade de exercer desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. Nosso dia a dia é movido por uma cultura inspiradora e inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferenças. Por isso, buscamos pessoas cada vez mais diversas e inovadoras para fazer parte desse propósito!

Se você também sonha alto (ao infinito e além!), tem paixão no que faz, tem garra (cai mas levanta!), trabalha com transparência, e quer um ambiente de trabalho onde você tenha a oportunidade de evoluir constantemente, a Jovens Gênios é o seu lugar!

Aqui, temos as melhores pessoas e todas se unem pelo mesmo propósito: transformar a educação mundial através da tecnologia e democratização de acesso.

Como Será o Seu Dia a Dia

  • Ambiente super divertido e descontraído;
  • Aprendizado contínuo;
  • Troca de ideias e de referências com pessoas de diferentes áreas;
  • Oportunidade REAL de crescimento;
  • Muitos desafios, porém com um time maravilhoso pra contar.

Requisitos

❗ Quais são as suas principais responsabilidades:

  • Assumir papel de liderança técnica no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicativos Web, garantindo altos padrões de qualidade, desempenho e escalabilidade;
  • Definir soluções e arquiteturas robustas, apoiando o time na tomada de decisões técnicas e na transformação de requisitos de negócio em entregas consistentes;
  • Atuar em parceria com designers de UI/UX, PMs e desenvolvedores para validar conceitos, antecipar riscos e propor abordagens mais eficientes;
  • Estabelecer, implementar e disseminar boas práticas de engenharia, mantendo alinhamento com padrões de código, qualidade e segurança;
  • Realizar code reviews aprofundados, mentorando desenvolvedores do time e contribuindo para o crescimento técnico coletivo;
  • Monitorar métricas críticas da plataforma, liderando diagnósticos e resoluções de problemas de alta complexidade;
  • Conduzir iniciativas de otimização e evolução contínua, identificando oportunidades e propondo melhorias que ampliem estabilidade e performance dos aplicativos;
  • Contribuir para a visão técnica da área, influenciando roadmap, padrões e processos internos.

❗Não Pode Faltar

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente);
  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento Web Fullstack, com atuação comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade;
  • Domínio de Next.js, React.js e TypeScript;
  • Conhecimento profundo em arquitetura de aplicações Web, incluindo SSR, SSG e padrões modernos de frontend;
  • Experiência sólida com APIs REST e GraphQL;
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL);
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de versionamento (Git/GitHub/GitLab);
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e melhores práticas de qualidade).

❗Vamos Amar Se Tiver Também

  • Experiência com monorepos e gestão de múltiplos pacotes;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura MVVM;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, Posthog, Grafana);
  • Experiência com design systems, bibliotecas de UI e estilização (TailwindCSS, Material UI, shadcn/ui);
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança Web e OWASP;
  • Experiência prévia com plataformas ou produtos educacionais.

Benefícios

❗ Você receberá todos os seu benefícios em um único cartão:

  • Vale alimentação e Vale refeição - Como dia o ditado: “Saco vazio não para em pé!”;
  • Auxílio home office - Para dar aquele gás na sua jornada, mesmo de casa;
  • Vale transporte nos dias presenciais - Para aqueles que ainda não usufruem do teletransporte;
  • Plano de saúde - Para você cuidar da sua saúde e ficar sempre novinho(a) em folha!;
  • Plano odontológico - Nós estamos sempre rindo, não é mesmo? Sendo assim, nada mais justo do que proporcionarmos aquela sorrisão bonito para você;
  • Day off no seu aniversário - Você escolhe como comemorar o seu grande dia!;
  • Day off na Vacinação;
  • TotalPass - com planos que dão acesso a todas as Smart Fit do país;
  • Descontos em cursos e universidades com os parceiros da Jovens Gênios;
  • Seguro de Vida e Assistência Funeral;
  • DHO - Uma plataforma com diversos cursos para você evoluir constantemente.

title: Sr Software Engineer, Frontend (Web)
description:
About the Role

Please note: this hybrid position is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil – welcoming both local professionals and those open to relocating.

At Uber, Frontend Engineers build web experiences that power the way people move and receive things around the world. As part of our engineering team, you’ll work on large-scale applications that impact millions of users.

You’ll collaborate with cross-functional partners (design, backend, data science, product). Your work will help shape the future of Uber’s Delivery, defining how people interact with Uber on the web.

About the Team

The Delivery team is focused on innovating and streamlining how products and services reach our customers. In this role, you'll contribute to building efficient and robust systems that support order processing, logistics, and real-time tracking. Your contributions will help optimize the end-to-end delivery experience, making it more reliable and seamless for both drivers and customers.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement user-facing features for critical web properties at scale, making engineering trade-offs between speed, maintainability, and user experience.

  • Own the technical design and execution of features, from initial architecture discussions to debugging production issues.

  • Collaborate across disciplines, Product, Design, Data Science, and Backend Engineering, to turn ambiguous business needs into clear, scalable front-end systems.

  • Champion front-end engineering excellence, defining and leading the adoption of code health, testing, and design standards within your project area.

  • Improve core application performance, efficiency, and system reliability, proactively identifying and tackling areas of technical debt in software and processes within your team.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on best practices, system design philosophy, and navigating cross-functional project dynamics.

What You’ll Need

  • 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on large-scale, high-traffic web applications.

  • Hands-on experience and proficiency in a modern web framework such as JavaScript, React, VueJS, or Angular, plus HTML and CSS.

  • Proficiency in fundamental algorithms and data structures, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked lists, DFS, and BFS.

  • Demonstrated understanding of modern web application architecture and design patterns, and their implications for performance and scalability.

  • Advanced English communication skills, written and verbal, to effectively collaborate with globally distributed cross-functional teams.

Bonus Points If

  • Experience leading the technical direction of complex, cross-functional projects with multiple dependencies.

  • Familiarity with back-end systems (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript) to facilitate collaboration and diagnose full-stack issues.

  • Experience with the full project lifecycle, from idea inception and stakeholder engagement to monitoring in production.

description:
Fiscal de Obras Pleno I (VAGA Extensiva Pessoas com Deficiência)

Somos a Concremat , uma plataforma de integração do grupo CCCC, que conecta o Brasil e a América Latina a uma rede global de especialistas. Mais do que fornecer soluções técnicas de engenharia, somos protagonistas na construção e viabilização de grandes projetos, sempre em parceria com nossas empresas-irmãs. Nosso propósito é claro: criar um futuro compartilhado, pautado no crescimento sustentável e na colaboração entre mercados, pessoas e tecnologias.

Atuamos em 15 países e mais de 200 localidades, ampliando constantemente nossa presença e impacto. Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão à além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Sobre a Abbott

Abbott é líder global em saúde, desenvolvendo uma ciência inovadora para melhorar a saúde das pessoas. Estamos sempre olhando para o futuro, antecipando mudanças na ciência e em tecnologias médicas.

Na Abbott, você pode realizar um trabalho importante, crescer e aprender, cuidar de si mesmo e de sua família, ser você mesmo e viver de maneira plena. Você terá acesso a:

Executar as rotinas de suporte e operação dos diversos equipamentos de embalagem, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos, normas de qualidade, de segurança e custos fabris definidos.

  • Executar atividades de limpeza de equipamentos e áreas produtivas de acordo com os procedimentos e padrões definidos;
  • Preparar soluções diversas utilizadas na limpeza e nos processos produtivos;

  • Operação de equipamentos de baixa, média ou alta complexidade, conforme procedimentos operacionais vigentes;
  • Auxiliar os demais operadores nas atividades de setup (montagem e desmontagem de máquina, movimentação de peças, etc);
  • Executar a limpeza e conservação de peças e componetes específicos dos equipamentos produtivos;

  • Realizar apontamentos de horas e entregas de quantidades no SAP, conforme procedimentos vigentes
  • Realizar ajustes mecânicos e trocas de formato de forma autônoma;
  • Inspecionar equipamentos de produção, auxiliando a manutenção na correção de defeitos e excutando manutenções corretivas e preventivas de baixa e média complexidade (exemplos: lubrificações, inspeções de máquina, troca de correias e rolamentos, etc);
  • Atuar na capacitação e treinamento de operadores mais novos em operação, ajustes e manutenções.

+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração

Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. description:
FARM | Auxiliar de Serviços de Loja | Centro II

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

você é uma pessoa que ama se conectar com gente e entender a história de cada cliente? aqui na FARM Rio, estamos à procura de quem se identifica com esses valores para fazer parte do nosso time de auxiliar de serviços de loja . buscamos pessoas que se desafiam a criar experiências incríveis em cada atendimento e a colocar o talento em campo para alcançar os melhores resultados, sempre buscando surpreender e encantar em cada detalhe, fazendo viva a nossa cultura: ser gente boa , bom de gente e bom de jogo .

quer fazer parte de um time apaixonado por moda e por gente? vem pra FARM!

  • executar rotinas relacionadas à limpeza e organização de toda a loja;
  • organizar o estoque, tornando o acesso às mercadorias mais eficiente;
  • realizar a revisão das mercadorias, para garantir a qualidade para os clientes;
  • cuidar da passadoria e reposição de peças no salão de vendas;
  • gerir, de forma eficiente, o processo de conferência, recebimento e envio de mercadorias;
  • participação em inventários;
  • apoiar o time de vendas no encantamento dos clientes:
  • oferecer suporte aos atendimentos realizados em loja e online, colaborando para uma experiência de compra mais positiva;
  • colaborar para que a loja permaneça atrativa, organizada e encantadora para os clientes, mantendo a ordem também nos provadores.
  • trabalhar bem em equipe, com espírito colaborativo e inclusivo;
  • facilidade de comunicação, com gentileza na oratória e “escutatória”;
  • ser comprometida com o ambiente de trabalho;
  • ser uma pessoa dinâmica, flexível, ágil de se adaptar e organizada;
  • ser proativa e colaborar para que a loja tenha um clima gentil, encantador e eficiente;
  • ter visão estratégica para entregar resultados e soluções de problemas;
  • ensino médio completo;
  • flexibilidade de horário.

quem faz parte do time comercial FARM tem direito à:

  • para garantir o seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:wellz (plataforma de saúde mental e bem estar)
  • assistência médica e odontológica com coparticipação;
  • política parental estendida: 180 dias para mães, 20 dias para pais
  • wellhub (Antigo Gympass)
  • day off, para curtir o seu aniversário;
  • e a melhor parte: descontos em roupas e acessórios da FARM e demais marcas do grupo Azzas.
  • Step 4: Validação do gente & gestão 4 Validação do gente & gestão

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
About Us

At MetaCTO, we specialize in helping startups and growing companies turn visionary ideas into successful digital products through expert app development and fractional CTO services. As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of the backend infrastructure that powers innovative applications for our clients. This role will involve managing cloud environments, optimizing databases, automating deployments, and improving system observability.

Job Description

As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at MetaCTO, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining highly available, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions. You will collaborate with software engineers to improve system performance, automate operations, and ensure the smooth functioning of critical backend services. You’ll work extensively with cloud platforms like AWS, leveraging technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI / CD pipelines to enhance system reliability.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS (Lambda, EC2, RDS, S3, EKS, SQS, CloudWatch).
  • Manage and optimize databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) for performance, reliability, and security.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to ensure system health and performance, with specific experience using Zabbix and Elastic Logging.
  • Design and maintain CI / CD pipelines for automated deployment and scaling of applications.
  • Work with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Develop and enforce security best practices for cloud environments and infrastructure.
  • Automate operational processes using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and scripting languages like Python or Bash.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related incidents and optimize system performance.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and scalable system design, with a strong focus on Django-based applications.

Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or Cloud Engineering roles.
  • Strong expertise in AWS cloud services (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, CloudFront, EKS, SQS, IAM).
  • Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS, or EKS).
  • Deep knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL), including performance tuning, query optimization, monitoring, and migration management.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
  • Strong experience with CI / CD pipelines and automation tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, or GitLab CI / CD).
  • Proficiency in monitoring tools, specifically Zabbix, and logging solutions like Elastic Logging.
  • Scripting experience with Python, Bash, or Go for automating operational tasks.
  • Experience working with Django-based applications in a cloud environment.
  • Experience implementing security best practices for cloud-based applications.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems and microservices architecture.

Preferred Skills

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
  • Experience with serverless computing and event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with message queue services (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Understanding of zero-downtime deployments and disaster recovery strategies.

Position Details

  • Type: Full‑Time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Hours: US Pacific Time hours

How to Apply

If you are passionate about scalability, automation, and reliability, and thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced environment, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and an optional brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

MetaCTO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to : Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience. Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity. Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows. Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast : prototype, test, iterate, and refine. Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Why Downstream

Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction. Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team. Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before. Competitive salary + equity

description:
Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name : Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group (

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves : is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted : treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you : wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different : we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model : you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product's modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position :

Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.

Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.

Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.

Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.

Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.

Champion a hands‑on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first‑hand customer / user insights.

Create a culture of decision‑making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.

Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)

Experience on B2B SaaS scale‑ups

Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth

A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers

Expertise in the end‑to‑end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices

An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills

Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit

Analytical abilities and problem‑solving skills

Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must

Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus

Hands‑on : In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000 and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;

Food / Market Voucher ;

Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;

Pet Plan;

iFeel app , for emotional comfort;

Gympass for you and up to 3 people!

Birthday Day Off;

Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;

Leave of Absence / Time‑off : in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

About The Project

We’re supporting a US homeowner who wants to redesign and expand their existing home. The project includes modifying current layouts, extending structural areas, adding new rooms, adjusting rooflines, and producing 2D/3D plans to visualize the new design before submission to a US-licensed professional. We do not require a US-licensed architect. Your job is to redesign, model, and prepare architectural drawings, and later a Texas‑licensed professional will take those drawings and submit them for permitting.

Role Summary

You will take the homeowner’s ideas (videos, measurements, sketches, existing blueprints) and convert them into professional architectural redesigns. Your deliverables will include updated floor plans, elevations, sections, and 3D models that clearly show how the redesigned spaces will look and function. The Texas‑licensed engineer/architect will later use your plans for code compliance, stamping, and permitting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing layout and homeowner‑provided videos describing the redesign vision.
  • Redesign interior and exterior spaces, including:
    • Third‑floor addition with bedroom + bathroom

    • Second‑floor bedroom + full bath redesign
    • Expanded deck and "bonus room" concepts
    • Sunroom / screened‑in patio addition with proper roofing
    • Semi‑open courtyard area with beams/pergola elements
  • Produce updated architectural drawings:
    • Floor plans
    • Roof plans
    • Elevations
    • Sections
  • Create detailed 3D models and visualizations that allow the homeowner to see the redesign before construction.
  • Ensure designs follow general residential construction principles (load paths, plumbing adjacency, access, roof slope, etc.).
  • Iterate quickly based on feedback.
  • Prepare a "plan set" that a US‑licensed professional can finalize, validate, and stamp for permitting.

Requirements

Must‑Have

  • Degree in Architecture, Architectural Design, or similar.
  • 4+ years of experience in residential remodels and additions.
  • Ability to interpret and modify existing house plans.
  • Strong portfolio that includes remodels, attic/loft conversions, roofline modifications, or sunrooms.
  • Proficiency with architectural and 3D modeling tools:
    • AutoCAD
    • SketchUp
    • Revit
    • Lumion / Twinmotion / Blender for rendering
  • Solid understanding of residential construction fundamentals (bearing walls, framing logic, roofing systems, plumbing routing, etc.).
  • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly with a US client.

Soft Skills

  • Strong spatial and architectural design intuition
  • High attention to detail
  • Fast iteration cycles
  • Clear communication and expectation‑setting
  • Practical and feasibility‑first approach

What We Offer

  • Remote, flexible work
  • USD compensation
  • Clear project brief and continuous feedback
  • Opportunity to work on a meaningful residential redesign for a US homeowner

Sobre a Organização

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades

description:
FIFA has created a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Senior Partnership Manager will be responsible for managing and delivering FIFA’s commercial partner rights at the local level, ensuring seamless coordination with the global FIFA Partnership Management team in Zurich. This includes day-to-day relationship management, operational delivery at venues and events where required, and strategic alignment with partner objectives within the host country and region.

Key responsibilities

  • Proactively lead and foster relationships with FIFA Commercial Partners operating in Brazil, ensuring consistent, high-quality servicing in line with global standards.
  • Act as the key local point of contact for assigned Commercial Partner, ensuring continuous alignment and close collaboration with the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich to maintain consistent servicing and delivery across all touchpoints.
  • Lead assigned partnership projects and deliverables related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ in Brazil, ensuring on-time, in-scope, and on-budget execution while identifying meaningful, locally relevant business and marketing opportunities that enhance partner impact and remain aligned with FIFA’s global partnership and brand strategy.
  • Project lead for assigned local partner activations and FIFA-related events in Brazil (e.g. Local Commercial Partner Workshops).
  • Ensure local partner activations and brand visibility adhere to FIFA’s third‑party regulations and brand protection standards, working in close coordination with the Commercial Legal and Brand teams.
  • Track and manage local partner budgets and support reconciliation processes in close coordination with the Zurich Partnerships team.
  • Prepare and lead meetings and updates with internal and external stakeholders, including regular reporting to the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich.
  • Provide solution‑oriented, proactive support to the Head of Commercial Partnerships in Brazil and contribute to a unified servicing approach across global and local workstreams.
  • Support continuous improvement by feeding local market insights and operational learnings into FIFA’s global partnership tools and client servicing frameworks.

Your profile

  • University degree required, preferably in Business, Marketing, Sports Management, or a related field
  • A solid understanding of the business of sports, marketing, and sponsorship rights delivery
  • Project and event management experience, ideally in an international environment
  • Working knowledge of digital and social media is an advantage
  • 6–8 years of experience in brand marketing, sponsorship, or client servicing in the sports or entertainment industry
  • Proven track record of managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders

description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products, from commissioning to field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Power Electronics Developers with expertise in motor control and battery management systems to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description

  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system, drive train, and battery management system architects and developers.
  • Design and develop motor drive and battery management circuits, PCBAs, and modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of motor drive and battery management system circuits, PCBAs, sub-assemblies, and electrical actuators.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop power electronics products.
  • Create test procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom power electronic designs.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Analog electronics, including discrete design with Opamps, transistors, inductors, transformers, and capacitors for high voltage designs.
  • Component selection of high voltage power semiconductors (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) for gate drives and analog/digital measurement circuits.
  • Power electronics design across various topologies in the AC or DC domain for motor controllers, battery management circuits, power supplies, and switches.
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of motor drive and battery control topologies, semiconductor component performance, and loss mechanisms.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal generators, programmable loads, motor, and battery simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Knowledge of control algorithms and embedded programming for circuit design verification.
  • Experience in power electronics design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to motor controller design in control system applications.

Qualifications:

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant power electronics development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

Skills

TechnipFMC promotes equal opportunities and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matter and we encourage you to add to our culture.

title: Engineer Who Can Design - Americas
description:
Engineer Who Can Design - Americas

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

This range is provided by Ashby. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$153,000.00/yr - $220,000.00/yr

Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. As someone who could design and build software, this position is close to my heart. I always felt I had a unique perspective because I could play with design ideas and iterate in code. My ideas could start in Figma but then be grounded (or sometimes more creative) in code. My prototypes used actual logic and data. My changes cascaded throughout the app for comprehensive critique (thanks, React component system!). But, every company made me pick one— I couldn’t design and build. At Ashby, you can.

While Every Engineer Can Design And Build, You’ll Tackle Our Most Challenging Design Problems And Help Others Improve Their Designs By Expanding And Enhancing Our In-house Design System And Consulting On Bespoke Work. To Ground It With Examples, Engineers Who Can Design At Ashby Have

  • Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using it to make the wireframes a reality.
  • Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build custom autocompletes. These autocompletes can contain filters, options to create new records, etc.
  • Helped another engineer improve their design's information hierarchy and scannability for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

These projects reflect what we’re accomplishing at Ashby: improving the productivity of working professionals (starting with talent teams) with intelligent and powerful software. We put a lot of effort into designing products that are approachable to beginners but mastered & extended by power users. In many ways, spreadsheets set the bar here.

We have many customers, great revenue growth, years of runway, and amazing investors like YCombinator, Elad Gil, and Lachy Groom. I’ll share more once we meet.

This is a staff-level role, so we require at least 5 years of experience as a full-time frontend engineer or evenly split between frontend and design for this role and significant contributions to (or leading) design systems.

Engineering Culture

Our engineering culture is motivated by Benji’s (my co-founder and CEO) and my belief that a small talented team, given the right environment, can build high-quality software fast (and work regular hours!).

Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate. Our engineering team (and the team at large) consists of lifelong learners who are humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally (we filter for it in interviews). We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers spend less than 4 hours per week in meetings (I wrote about it here).

Increase Leverage, not Team Size. We Built Ashby With The Quality, Breadth, And Depth That Many Customers Would Expect From Much Larger Teams Over Larger Time Scales. We’ve Done This Through Investment In

  • Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 10x a day. Everyone on the team has contributed to developer experience
  • Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) which we are constantly improving. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app.

And a Demo Of One Of These Building Blocks. Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby.

Give Engineers Ownership & Autonomy. We, as engineers, find clever ways to solve problems, which amplifies when we deeply understand the problem. Benji and I did our best work as engineers when we had a deep understanding of the end-user and the business and ownership over the solution. Our engineering culture reflects this experience: engineers own projects end-to-end, from speaking with users to writing product specs to UX design. These are skills that we often don’t get to practice as engineers, and, at Ashby, we provide mentorship to grow them and help from the team where you want it.

Put Effort into Diversity. Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. Having seen my mother and partner build their careers as minority women in non-diverse fields, I want to make sure Ashby creates opportunities for the next generation of engineers from underrepresented groups (including my daughter!). Today, 26% of engineers at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. It’s not great, and we are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.

Interview Process

At Ashby, Our Team And Interview Process Want To Help You Show Your Best Self. We’ll Dive Into Past Projects And Simulate Working Together Via Pair Programming, Writing Tech Specs Collaboratively, And Talking Through Decisions (no Leetcode Or Whiteboard Exercises). Our Interview Process Is Three Rounds With Some Casual Zoom (or In-person) Coffee In Between To Get To Know Each Other

  • 30-minute introduction call to discuss Ashby and your past work (we demo Ashby!)
  • A technical screen (take home or, for more experienced folks who want it, a 90-minute live session)
  • A virtual on-site of 3 hours and 45 minutes (can be split across two days)

Your hiring manager will be your main point of contact and prepare you for interviews. You’ll meet other engineering leaders and 4 to 6 engineers (with 15 minutes in each interview to ask them questions). If we don’t give an offer, we’ll provide feedback!

Your First Two Months at Ashby

We want an exceptional onboarding experience for every new hire. At Ashby, your dev environment sets up with a single script, you push your first change on day one, and we spend the rest of the time building your confidence in our codebase and practices culminating in delivering a prominent, impactful feature. We’ll pair you with a peer who’ll guide you through your first tasks and be someone you rely on, from answering questions to pair programming.

Technology Stack

Our tech stack is TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, a mix of SASS modules and Stitches, Apollo GraphQL, Node.js, Postgres, and Redis. We're looking for folks with deep React, CSS, and HTML knowledge for this role.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby — do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one‑on‑one agenda until you start taking it

Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Instructional Designer to lead the design, development, and delivery of innovative e-learning and blended learning solutions in Brazil. In this role, you will combine hands-on instructional design with leadership and project management responsibilities, guiding a team of designers, developers, and external partners while ensuring the delivery of high-quality learning experiences and adherence to our global development framework. Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English are essential.

This is a newly formed role and part of our expansion in Brazil. The successful candidate will bring an entrepreneurial mindset, helping to shape the function and drive local growth, while collaborating closely with our established global teams. You will benefit from clear frameworks and support but also have the opportunity to influence and innovate within our learning design approach.

This is a full-time position based in our training centre in Rio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Instructional Design: Analyse learning needs to scope and design engaging and effective e-learning solutions
  • Instructional Design: Develop learning objectives, storyboards and assessments for both e-learning and blended learning products which are aligned with adult learning principles and comply with industry standards
  • Instructional Design: Apply instructional design models and learning methodologies to create engaging e-learning experiences which align with Maersk Training’s standards, style guides, processes, procedures and templates.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and coach a team of instructional designers and e-learning developers.
  • Team Leadership: Assign and oversee tasks, providing guidance and constructive feedback to ensure quality and consistency of products.
  • Team Leadership: Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performance team culture.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct performance reviews and support team members’ professional development.
  • Project Management: Manage multiple e-learning projects end-to-end, ensuring delivery on scope, quality, timeline, and budget.
  • Project Management: Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and resource allocation.
  • Project Management: Work closely with the existing Digital Content Team and L&D Managers in the development of learning products.
  • Project Management: Serve as the main point of contact for stakeholders, SMEs, and clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment of expectations.
  • Project Management: Monitor project risks, dependencies, and quality assurance processes.
  • Project Management: Drive continuous improvement in instructional design processes and project management practices.
  • Project Management: The confidence to balance competing priorities, and maintain high standards in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

We are looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in instructional design/e-learning development, including 3–4 years in team leadership or project management.
  • Proven success managing cross-functional teams and complex e-learning projects.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
  • Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English, with the ability to adapt learning and communication styles to ensure training is relevant and accessible to both local and international audiences.

title: Partnership Business Development Executive
description:
ABOUT US

Chiliz - the world’s leading sports-focused blockchain Tech company, is leading the charge into Web3, building a global ecosystem where fans don’t just watch the game, they become a part of it. If you’re ready to put on your jersey and get to work alongside a dynamic global team, this could be the perfect match.

OUR BRANDS

  • Chiliz: The backbone of our ecosystem, creator of Chiliz Chain - the Layer 1 blockchain that powers our vision of Web3 for sports and entertainment.
  • Fan Tokens: Official Digital Assets for more than 70 of the world’s biggest sports teams, including giants like Paris Saint Germain, Man City, FC Barcelona.
  • Socios.com: The Web3 Fan Token Wallet and home of Fan Token rewards.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a self-starter with exceptional business acumen who can navigate complex stakeholder environments. You should be comfortable operating independently while collaborating across teams, possess strong analytical capabilities, and demonstrate genuine enthusiasm for the intersection of sports, technology, and finance. Your ability to identify creative partnership opportunities and execute them will be critical to success in this role.

Due to the global scope of Chiliz, this role requires fluency in both English and Portuguese. Please submit your CV In English.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnerships with retail networks, financial institutions, investment firms, and other potential distribution channels for fan tokens and Chiliz products
  • Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers across banking, sports organizations, and crypto-related businesses in Brazil
  • Create compelling business proposals, pitch decks, and partnership frameworks tailored to prospective partners' needs and objectives
  • Conduct market analysis to identify emerging opportunities and competitive dynamics in the Brazilian digital asset and sports engagement landscape
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful partnership implementation and ongoing relationship management
  • Represent Socios.com/Chiliz at industry events, conferences, and client meetings
  • Track partnership performance metrics and provide regular reports on business development activities and pipeline status

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in business development, sales, or partnerships, preferably within the financial services/banking sector. Preferably knowledge of web3, and could be sports related.
  • Proven track record of successfully closing complex B2B partnerships and achieving revenue targets
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian financial services landscape and regulatory environment
  • Excellent presentation and negotiation skills with ability to influence C-level executives
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (written and verbal)
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Direct experience or demonstrated interest in sports industry partnerships and sponsorships
  • Knowledge of cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and digital asset markets
  • Existing network within Brazilian banking, retail, or investment sectors
  • Experience drafting commercial agreements and partnership terms

WHAT WE OFFER

The chance to join a global community of sports blockchain enthusiasts spanning 6 countries and over 40 nationalities, committed to building a vibrant, exciting Web3 future for sports alongside some of the biggest names on the planet. We’re looking for team players who are happy to try, fail, and bounce back because a great team is all about the comeback.

We believe the interview process is a two-way street. Think of it as a draft where we're both trying to make the best pick. Our competitive salaries, wellness allowance, healthcare, and pension plans are just the tip of the iceberg. You’ll be joining a diverse, global team, where flexibility and challenge are part of the playbook.

Ready to play? Let’s get to work.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with strong personal standards for flawless execution.

Proactive Communication – Solutions-oriented communication that is clear and timely across departments and time zones.

Fast-Paced Execution – Weekly optimizations and QA routines are non-negotiable.

Continuous Improvement – We are always refining our systems to push performance higher.

Success Metrics

  • 100% of weekly optimization routines completed on time.
  • Campaign pacing within ±5% of budget plan.
  • Negative keyword coverage improves irrelevant query share quarter-over-quarter.
  • Reporting completeness rate 95%+ as measured by manager audit.

Compensation, Benefits, and Schedule

Schedule : Flexible work hours but must be available for mandatory 4-hour team overlap for collaboration with cross-department teams.

Multi-Step Hiring Process

  • Final interview and debrief with the manager and CEO.

title: Analista de Suporte N2 - Redes
description:
Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável, resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3.

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade: testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio); identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar): verificar potência RX/TX das ONUs, ONUs flutuantes (online/offline) e erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP: sessões PPPoE travadas; cliente autenticando e não navegando; cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução.

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes.
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE.
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping, tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em pelo menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT, BNG e BRAS.
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6.
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA, etc.).
  • Experiência comprovada em provedor de internet, com habilidade em resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão e gerenciamento de plantões.

title: Power Electronics Developer
description:
Job Purpose

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team: The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products, from commissioning to field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Power Electronics Developers with expertise in motor control and battery management systems to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description
  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system, drive train, and battery management system architects and developers.
  • Design and develop motor drive and battery management circuits, PCBAs, and modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of motor drive and battery management system circuits, PCBAs, sub-assemblies, and electrical actuators.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop power electronics products.
  • Create test procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom power electronic designs.
You are meant for this job if:
  • Analog electronics, including discrete design with Opamps, transistors, inductors, transformers, and capacitors for high voltage designs.
  • Component selection of high voltage power semiconductors (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) for gate drives and analog/digital measurement circuits.
  • Power electronics design across various topologies in the AC or DC domain for motor controllers, battery management circuits, power supplies, and switches.
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of motor drive and battery control topologies, semiconductor component performance, and loss mechanisms.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, signal generators, programmable loads, motor, and battery simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Knowledge of control algorithms and embedded programming for circuit design verification.
  • Experience in power electronics design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to motor controller design in control system applications.

Qualifications:

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant power electronics development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Exciting global R&D environment.
  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • State-of-the-art development environment.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the role

Darkroom is seeking a dedicated and experienced Recruiting Manager to lead our talent acquisition team and strategy. You will be the crucial link between our senior leadership and the execution of our hiring plan, ensuring we attract and hire top talent efficiently and effectively to support Darkroom’s ambitious growth goals.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Coordinate the daily activities, priorities, and resources of the recruiting team (including Senior Recruiters, Recruiters, and Coordinators) to ensure alignment with company objectives and hiring targets.

  • Strategic Partnership (SPOC): Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Darkroom's senior leadership, providing regular updates, strategic insights, and recommendations on hiring status, market conditions, and talent pipeline health.

  • Hiring Plan Execution: Own the delivery of the overall hiring plan. Proactively ensure all open positions are filled in the right time, managing requisition load and balancing team efforts across various departments (e.g., Engineering, Product, G&A, Sales).

  • Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and refine our end-to-end recruitment processes, tools, and systems to maximize efficiency, candidate experience, and hiring quality.

  • Data & Reporting: Develop and present key recruiting metrics, reports, and dashboards to senior leadership, leveraging data to drive decision-making and forecast hiring needs.

  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external recruiting agencies, sourcing partners, and vendors as needed.

  • Recruiter Development: Mentor, coach, and develop the recruiting team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, high performance, and deep business acumen.

Standard Requirements

  • Experience: A minimum of 5+ years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruiting, with at least 2 years of experience managing, leading, or mentoring a team of recruiters.

  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead and motivate a high-performing recruiting team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and articulate hiring strategy and data to executive-level stakeholders.

  • Strategic Mindset: Demonstrated experience in translating business objectives into tactical recruiting strategies and operational plans.

  • Process Acumen: Deep understanding of full-cycle recruiting, best practices, and the ability to implement effective sourcing, interviewing, and closing strategies.

  • System Knowledge: Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) (e.g., Greenhouse, Lever) and experience using data visualization/reporting tools.

  • Compliance: Strong knowledge of employment laws and compliance regulations related to hiring.

Why Darkroom

Darkroom builds the future of how brands grow. As Recruitment Manager, you’ll support that mission — helping shape the company by ensuring we pick the right candidates that make us what we are. You’ll collaborate with world-class operators, creatives, and data minds to build the next generation of marketing excellence.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Health & Wellness: Company‑sponsored medical, dental, and vision benefits with, so you can stay as healthy as can be.

Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

Opportunity Statement

Do you want to work hard, have fun and make history? If you do then Amazon could be the right career choice for you.   • Manage the onboarding process of new EDSPs until its launch.

  • Work on continuous improvement initiatives, including benchmarks with other geos.

Basic Qualifications

  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Logistics and Transportation.

title: Recruitment Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the role

Darkroom is seeking a dedicated and experienced Recruiting Manager to lead our talent acquisition team and strategy. You will be the crucial link between our senior leadership and the execution of our hiring plan, ensuring we attract and hire top talent efficiently and effectively to support Darkroom’s ambitious growth goals.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Coordinate the daily activities, priorities, and resources of the recruiting team (including Senior Recruiters, Recruiters, and Coordinators) to ensure alignment with company objectives and hiring targets.
  • Strategic Partnership (SPOC): Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Darkroom's senior leadership, providing regular updates, strategic insights, and recommendations on hiring status, market conditions, and talent pipeline health.
  • Hiring Plan Execution: Own the delivery of the overall hiring plan. Proactively ensure all open positions are filled in the right time, managing requisition load and balancing team efforts across various departments (e.g., Engineering, Product, G&A, Sales).
  • Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and refine our end-to-end recruitment processes, tools, and systems to maximize efficiency, candidate experience, and hiring quality.
  • Data & Reporting: Develop and present key recruiting metrics, reports, and dashboards to senior leadership, leveraging data to drive decision-making and forecast hiring needs.
  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external recruiting agencies, sourcing partners, and vendors as needed.
  • Recruiter Development: Mentor, coach, and develop the recruiting team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, high performance, and deep business acumen.

Standard Requirements

  • Experience: A minimum of 5+ years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruiting, with at least 2 years of experience managing, leading, or mentoring a team of recruiters.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to lead and motivate a high-performing recruiting team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and articulate hiring strategy and data to executive-level stakeholders.
  • Strategic Mindset: Demonstrated experience in translating business objectives into tactical recruiting strategies and operational plans.
  • Process Acumen: Deep understanding of full-cycle recruiting, best practices, and the ability to implement effective sourcing, interviewing, and closing strategies.
  • System Knowledge: Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) (e.g., Greenhouse, Lever) and experience using data visualization/reporting tools.
  • Compliance: Strong knowledge of employment laws and compliance regulations related to hiring.

Why Darkroom

Darkroom builds the future of how brands grow. As Recruitment Manager, you’ll support that mission — helping shape the company by ensuring we pick the right candidates that make us what we are. You’ll collaborate with world-class operators, creatives, and data minds to build the next generation of marketing excellence.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Work-Life Balance: We recognize that time away from work is essential for growth and well-being. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have the time you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance and perform at your best.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona! For NYC and Lisbon applicants a Hybrid model will be required.
  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision benefits with, so you can stay as healthy as can be.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
